div.head: II Cn 84.2a
div.ab: And wel þære heorde, ðe gefolgað þam hyrde, þe hig deoflum ætweneð ⁊ Gode hig gestryneð.
And wel ðære heorde, ðe gefolgað ðam hyrde, ðe hig deoflum ætwenað ⁊ Gode hig gestreonað.
And wel þare heorde, þe gefolgað þam hyrde, þe hig deoflum ætweneð ⁊ Gode hy gestryneð.
Et exultatio gregi, qui pastori paruit, per quem segregatus erit a diabolo, multiplicatus autem Deo.
Bene erit etiam illi gregi, qui illum pastorem sequitur, qui se a diabolo abstrahit et adhereat Deo.
And wel ðære heorde ðe gefolgað ðam hyrde ðe hig deoflum ætwenað ⁊ Gode hig gestreonað.
And wel þære heorde, ðe gefolgað þam hyrde þe hig deoflum ætweneð and Gode hig gestryneð.
Und wohl der Herde, die dem Hirten folgt, der sie Teufeln entzieht und sie Gott gewinnt.
And well for the flock that follows the shepherd who withdraws it from devils and wins it for God.
And well is it for the flock which follows the shepherd who delivers them from devils and wins them for God.
And it shall go well for the flock which follows the shepherd who delivers them from devils and redeems them for God.
